change_notes: Dielectric tensor values are retained, with larger type and a shared legend.
Derived properties display only diagonal xx, yy, zz; scalar formulas are not applied independently to off-diagonal entries.
Absorption uses angular frequency E/hbar and units nm^-1; the old PDF amplitudes were smaller by 2*pi.

Main-text dielectric figures retain the xx/zz (and xy where present) layout, real and imaginary rows, original dark/light colors and solid line styles. The original xy energy windows of 0-2 eV and 0-16 eV are retained.
Main-text loss, reflectivity, refractive-index and extinction curves match and retain the original diagonal HSE06 data and scalar formulas.

Monolayer dielectric panels retain the original xx/zz components, PBE source values, material colors and solid-real/dashed-imaginary styles. A shared real/imaginary legend is placed below the last row.
The five monolayer optical PDFs use 8 x 2.1 inch pages and one shared material legend below the extinction row. The old bilayers title is corrected to monolayers.

Monolayer loss, refractive-index and extinction source values and formulas are unchanged. Reflectivity uses the already-existing S1.14d_correct.pdf reference, verified from the same NPZ data; the older S1.14d.pdf was not modified.

visual_review.thesis_integrated_layout_review: pending root build; all main and monolayer figures should use full text width
visual_review.numeric_verification: 291 original-reference curves and 291 revised-PDF curves matched against exact NPZ source values. An additional 12 failed old-monolayer-reflectivity comparisons are retained separately as evidence of the old reference error.

monolayer_reflectivity_reference_correct.interpretation: The thesis previously referenced the older file. The existing corrected PDF matches all twelve curves to the same four monolayer NPZ sources. Its source values are retained in the enlarged-font redraw. The unreferenced old S1.14d.pdf is not altered.
